{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Fitted fine-gauge crew-neck knit, hip length, deep burgundy #6D1F2E, merino wool
Midi A-line skirt, softly flared, falling just below the knee, black #1C1C1E, crepe with a soft drape
Single-breasted straight coat, knee length, camel #B98B5E, wool-blend with a soft brushed texture
Ankle boots, sleek almond toe, low block heel of about 5 cm, black #1C1C1E, smooth leather
Small structured shoulder bag, black #1C1C1E, leather
Small gold-tone hoop earrings, #C9A24B, polished metal
Thin leather belt on the skirt waist, black #1C1C1E, smooth leather

This outfit suits a restaurant date: it looks polished and feminine without feeling overdressed for a casual evening venue. The burgundy knit is warm and flattering in artificial restaurant lighting, and the soft skirt adds movement. The camel coat keeps you comfortable on an autumn evening and can be left at the coat check. The low block heel makes it easy to walk and sit for hours, and the black accents tie everything together."}
